cases.name: a-statistic-that-does-not-say-what-to-summarise
cases.description: A statistic reads another column and draws nothing of its own, so of= is not optional. Without it there is no column to read and the sequence would render empty on every row.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Price"><gen type="text" value="10,20"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><gen type="stat" op="mean"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-statistic-that-does-not-say-which-one
cases.description: op= is the statistic itself: sum, mean, median, min, max, count or stddev. Without it the generator names a column and says nothing about what to do with it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Price"><gen type="text" value="10,20"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><gen type="stat" of="Price"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-statistic-op-that-is-not-one
cases.description: A misspelled op is answered with the near name rather than with silence, the same way a misspelled function in an expression is. The list is short enough to print in full.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Price"><gen type="text" value="10,20"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><gen type="stat" of="Price" op="men"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-statistic-reading-a-column-that-is-not-declared-above-it
cases.description: A statistic is built in declaration order out of a column that already exists, so of= takes the same rule parent= and a running total take. The code is shared with running deliberately: it is the same rule with the same fix, and a second code for it would lengthen the error reference without telling a reader anything new.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Price"><gen type="text" value="10,20"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><gen type="stat" of="Prices" op="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>
